offering_description.value: Operates an online marketplace connecting hosts who list homes and other stays with guests seeking short- and long-term accommodations. It also offers bookable local experiences and services. It earns fees from hosts and guests on each booking through its website and apps.

primary_services.value: online lodging marketplace; booking of local experiences; host and guest payment processing; services such as guest support and host tools

customer_segment.value: B2C: Travelers booking stays and experiences, individual hosts listing properties; B2B: Professional property managers and boutique hotels listing inventory

end_markets.value: travel and tourism; short-term lodging; hospitality; local experiences

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: service fees charged to guests and hosts as a share of each booking; transaction or usage fees: fees on experiences and services booked through the platform
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; transaction or usage fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: two-sided marketplace matching hosts' listings with guests, via website and apps; financial intermediary: processes payments between guests and hosts, holding funds until check-in

geography_served.value: global: Listings in over 220 countries and regions worldwide

specialization.value: related lines: stays marketplace, experiences and services, all on one booking platform

distribution_channels.value: online: Airbnb website and mobile apps; partners / resellers: channel managers and property-management software integrations feeding listings

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Short-term rental laws, local zoning and registration rules, tax collection, consumer protection and data privacy rules
